tldr_md:
# Acme webhook signature mismatch blocking BigCo pilot

Sarah at BigCo opened a support thread on 2026-04-28 about HMAC signature validation failing on the Acme v2 webhook in staging. She needs to know whether the signing secret is per-environment or per-workspace. Two weeks in, she still does not have an answer. The pilot launch is in four days (2026-05-15) and she is now threatening to escalate internally and reassess the timeline. Managed delivery (suggested by Alex) is not viable — BigCo's compliance review of the current architecture took six weeks and cannot be redone.
open_questions: Is the Acme webhook signing secret per-environment or per-workspace?
When will the Acme integrations team respond with a definitive answer?
Can Acme schedule a call between Sarah and the integrations team today?

commitments.what: Loop in the integrations team and return with a definitive answer on signing secret behavior
Chase the integrations team and provide a concrete answer
Ship the Acme webhook integration to production for the pilot launch

suggested_reply_md:
Hi Sarah,

You are right to push — this has gone on too long and I own the delay. Setting expectations straight:

- **Signing secret answer, today.** I am pinging our integrations lead directly the moment I send this and will reply on this thread with the definitive per-environment vs per-workspace answer before end of business today.
- **Call with integrations, today or tomorrow.** I will hold a 30-minute slot with our integrations engineer for any time you pick in the next 24 hours. Reply with two windows that work and I will confirm one.
- **Managed delivery is off the table** — understood, we will not raise it again. We will solve the signature mismatch in your current architecture.
- **Pilot date.** I know you are launching 2026-05-15. We will treat this as a P1 on our side until you are unblocked.

If I do not have the signing-secret answer to you by end of business, please escalate to my manager, Priya Rao (priya@acme.example), and I will brief her in advance.

Apologies for the runaround.

Alex
